changelog: Vortex v5.1.1: Fixes logins failing when the Riot Client reloads its sign-in page mid-typing, which left the username filled and the password box empty. The page is now left to settle first, and both boxes are re-checked before anything is submitted - if the page reset, the credentials are simply entered again in the same window. Retry no longer force-closes the client either: it retries in the window that's already open, and the client is only restarted once, as a last resort, before giving up.
